hypothesis: Pending actions bound only to ticker and share count can survive a full close and be applied to a reopened lot; binding every action to current-lot lifecycle identity and expiring lifecycle mismatches will prevent stale overrides without changing strategy rules or order submission.
change_summary: Bind pending execution memory to account+ticker+direction+verified current-lot entry date, persist terminal reconciliation, and fail closed on stale, ambiguous, malformed, or non-PIT identity.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: No new alpha is claimed. The production-safety hypothesis is that a pending action must follow one exact current lot, never a ticker across full exits and re-entry.
pre_run_questions.2_history_check: exp-20260711-006 was invalidated because Moomoo reused position_id across a full exit/re-entry; exp-20260711-009 accepted current-quantity-anchored entry-date reconstruction as the current-lot boundary.
pre_run_questions.3_single_policy_bundle: pending_action_position_lifecycle_binding_v1: bind, reconcile, persist, migrate legacy rows, and fail closed when identity is not provable.
pre_run_questions.4_success_failure_standard: Old actions cannot override a reopened lot; same-lot actions still repeat until share reconciliation; malformed or non-PIT state cannot close or rebind actions; no strategy/backtest/order behavior changes.
pre_run_questions.5_reproducibility: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m pytest quant\test_pending_actions.py quant\test_llm_advisor_paths.py quant\test_run_intraday_wiring.py quant\test_open_position_schema.py quant\test_open_position_accounting.py quant\test_moomoo_open_positions.py -q

parameters.legacy_migration: bind only when current entry_date is strictly earlier than first_advice_date; supersede later lots; quarantine same-day ambiguity

gate1.note: Measurement repair only; canonical strategy behavior is outside the changed surface.

gate2.sentinel_note: Current production rows have entry_date; position_id is explicitly retained only as audit evidence because the broker can reuse it after a full exit.

acceptance_basis: The live stale MCD action is inactive and auditable, current open pending actions are empty, valid same-lot reminders retain prior behavior, every unsafe identity/state boundary fails closed, and all focused, related, and core tests pass without strategy metric changes.
next_retry_requires: A concrete concurrent-writer race before adding ledger compare-and-swap or file locking.
A real multi-account same-ticker case before changing the current one-account-per-snapshot index.
Broker fill timestamp or contributing deal id before resolving same-day full-exit/re-entry identity instead of quarantining it.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The old ledger discarded account, direction, and entry_date; reconciliation was in-memory only, and repeated pending reminders could be re-registered. Moomoo position_id is not lot identity. Binding to the verified current-lot entry date and persisting terminal state removes both stale matching and resurrection.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not restore ticker/share-only matching, use broker position_id as the lifecycle key, or reconstruct historical pending actions from today's holdings without point-in-time position snapshots.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Only reopen this surface for a demonstrated concurrent-write loss, a multi-account collision, a corporate-action/transfer case, or sub-day broker fill identity that can safely replace the current quarantine.

known_limitations: Current-lot entry_date is day-granular, so same-day legacy identity is quarantined.
The snapshot account is an operator label rather than a persisted broker account id.
Atomic writes prevent partial files but do not provide compare-and-swap concurrency control.
reproduction_commands: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -B -m pytest quant\test_pending_actions.py quant\test_llm_advisor_paths.py quant\test_run_intraday_wiring.py quant\test_open_position_schema.py quant\test_open_position_accounting.py quant\test_moomoo_open_positions.py -q
notes: Accepted measurement repair only. The report/position-control ordering issue was deliberately not changed here: the existing control surface is observe-only and report-text-dependent, so hard-gating it requires a separate structured adapter and policy evaluation.
